orchestratorDecisions: Each lane runs in its own git worktree outside the repo (C:/git/ht-lanes/lane-<x>) so parallel lanes never switch branches under each other and jest in the main tree never scans lane copies.

Lane D starts in parallel with its independent issues; only #317 and #304 wait for lane A to merge (SPRINT.md §3 'Lane D waits for lane A to merge into sprint/auto-fixes before starting #304 and #317'). #304 runs last per 'Lane D: #304 last'.

Test-file ownership: lane G owns jest.config.js and #336, but every developer must write a regression test, so each lane owns the tests for its own modules: A=src/db/__tests__/**, B=src/services/__tests__/**, C=src/screens/__tests__/analyticsHelpers.test.ts + src/screens/__tests__/AnalyticsDashboardScreen*.test.tsx, D=src/screens/__tests__/{Settings,MealPrep,Dashboard}Screen*.test.tsx, E=src/api/__tests__/**. Lane G runs last so there is no concurrent editor.

#315 (lane A) spans database.ts and backup.ts validatePayload. Lane A is granted validatePayload in src/services/backup.ts + its tests in src/services/__tests__/backup.test.ts ONLY after lane B has merged into integration and integration has been merged into lane A. If lane B has not merged when lane A reaches #315, lane A defers #315 and continues.

#317 (lane D) is a database.ts/schema.ts fix. It runs after lane A merges, on a lane D branch refreshed from integration, and is granted the workout_set_log functions in src/db/database.ts, an appended migration in src/db/schema.ts, and src/db/__tests__/** for its test. No concurrent lane-A editor exists by then, so migration numbering cannot collide.

#335 (lane F) edits src/db/README.md and the schema.ts header. It runs after lane A merges, on a lane F branch refreshed from integration, so the docs describe the post-sprint db layer. Granted: src/**/README.md, the header comment of src/db/schema.ts only, CLAUDE.md.
#310 (lane B): the SettingsScreen success-alert wording is lane D territory; lane B stays in backup.ts/notifications.ts and reports any criterion it cannot meet in-lane.
